name: services/meetings/meetings
description: Get information about a multiple meetings.
brief_description: Get information about a multiple meetings.

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector may contain any subset of fields, which are described in the returns section of meeting method.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: A dictionary that will map your meeting_ids to meeting objects, as defined in the meeting method or null if meeting with such ID does not exist.
